> 📘 Prerequisites of a cVRP transaction
>
> Commercial VRP is scoped to a defined set of eligible sectors. Before building your integration, confirm that your use case falls within one of the categories listed in the [cVRP overview](https://modulr.readme.io/docs/cvrp-overview#eligible-use-cases-cvrp1).
>
> If you are unsure whether your use case is in scope, speak to your Modulr point of contact before proceeding.
